The background features a large screen with a celestial blue night theme and silhouettes of a tall castle. She has short black hair and keeps her arms crossed while looking toward the man with a neutral facial expression. The lighting is bright studio lighting, creating sharp shadows on the background screen behind her. (3) The man continues his monologue, pointing toward the audience and then back at the woman. Next to him is a small silver table holding a tall metal pitcher and a single red rose. The stage floor is dark, and the overall color tone is vibrant and slightly cool due to the screen. The camera maintains a medium full shot, capturing their movements and the decorative props on the table between them. The background castle graphics remain static throughout this scene. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting their facial expressions and the glossy texture of the silver pitcher sitting on the small table. Her expression is one of triumphant joy as she holds the transformed prop high for everyone to see. (9) The man reacts with exaggerated surprise, clapping his hands and shouting enthusiastically. The woman laughs, holding the bouquet and the empty tube. She eventually begins to walk off stage toward the right, while the man continues to address the audience with a broad, smiling expression.
